question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No.4.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'ecologically'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us look into the **meaning **of the given **options** - 

 
 
• ecologically - in a way that concerns the relation of living organisms to one another and to their physical surroundings.
 
• physically - in a manner relating to the body as opposed to the mind.
 
• socially - in a way that relates to society or its organization.
 
• economically - in a way that relates to economics or finance.
 
 
 
• From the line with the blank, we can infer that **blank 4 **needs a word that would refer to the natural benefit of tree plantation. 
 
• Hence, ecologically is the most appropriate option for blank 4. 
 
• So, option 1 is the correct answer.

Correct paragraph__ - *Tree plantation is the (1)__process__ of transplanting saplings or seeds to maximise the amount of greenery and focus on promoting (2)__afforestation__. Planting trees can be a very rewarding and fruitful (3)__endeavour__! Not only is it (4)__ecologically__ beneficial for this planet, but it also contributes to helping create an environmentally friendly place to live, as trees help reduce pollutant (5)__concentration__.*
